change.contract: Each GQA query-head warp cooperatively preloads disjoint BF16 K/V token offsets once per KV head, then preserves the canonical D64 reduction and online-softmax token order for every query head.

tests.name: grouped_ragged_d64_gqa_attention_matches_cpu_for_all_lanes_and_zeroes_tail
tests.coverage: QH=9/KVH=3 direct GPU-to-CPU parity, page boundary, inactive-row zero tail, and byte determinism

tests.name: active_row_buckets_match_fixed_maximum_across_decode_mixed_and_kv_boundaries
tests.command: RILEY_REAL_CHECKPOINT=/model cargo test --locked --offline -p riley-runtime --features cuda --test llama_batch_gpu active_row_buckets_match_fixed_maximum_across_decode_mixed_and_kv_boundaries -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
tests.coverage: active rows 1/2/8/17, mixed prefill/decode, KV 15-to-16 and 16-to-17, history boundaries, exact top-1 parity

tests.name: real_cuda_http_lifecycle_is_bounded_and_consistent
tests.command: RILEY_REAL_CHECKPOINT=/model cargo test --locked --offline -p riley-server --features 'server cuda' --test api_gpu real_cuda_http_lifecycle_is_bounded_and_consistent -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
tests.coverage: real CUDA HTTP lifecycle and bounded generation

known_limit: Malformed metadata is rejected by host-side validation. A direct device-path corruption-to-NaN case is a follow-up hardening test, not part of this release gate.
